name: two-agents
description: A local desktop app that orchestrates OpenAI Codex CLI and Claude Code as worker/reviewer agents.

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently -k -n vite,electron-tsc,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
